paragraphs.text: Identity-safe process monitoring capability for Relay on DeepSeek Harness.

> **Stable `0.1.2` is verified on official DSH `0.1.5-rc.2`
> and `0.1.6-alpha.1`.** No implementati

on adaptation was required; its peer

This extension supplies a read-only, identity-safe process status capability for
Agent-authored Rela

y Monitor Bundles. It deliberately does not add a prebuilt Bundle
Type: the Agent discovers no proce

ss type, issues an authorized Process Handle, and
uses the `relay-monitor-author` Skill to create a

authorized Process Handle, and
uses the `relay-monitor-author` Skill to create a task-scoped Bundle.
Install the exact public release together with Monitor Core and Author:
The same artifacts retain compatibility with audited DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` profiles.

The plugin issues opaque, Session- and project-bound Process Handles. A PID is
accepted only at hand
le issuance and is never embedded in a custom Bundle.
